name: beatra-skills
description: Beatra creative production skills. Each entry installs one skill from its own repository.

plugins.name: beatra
plugins.description: Create AI images, videos, music, and voice, look up public social data, edit supported visual results, and keep returned files and credit use easy to track through one shared connection.

plugins.name: talking-avatar-video
plugins.description: Turn one portrait and a short script or speech track into a directed talking-avatar video for explainers, announcements, lessons, and product messages.

plugins.name: ai-logo-maker
plugins.description: Turn a brand name, industry, or reference image into a professional AI logo, brand mark, or app icon with multi-concept exploration, precise brand colors, and scalable composition.

plugins.name: music-generation-studio
plugins.description: Turn a theme, lyric, scene, or reference audio into reviewable songs, instrumentals, BGM, and soundtracks with a clear creative direction and focused revisions.

plugins.name: product-photo-studio
plugins.description: Transform a real product photo into a studio-quality ecommerce image, lifestyle scene, or marketplace-ready hero shot with clean backgrounds, professional lighting, and composition guided by confirmed product details.

plugins.name: suno-lyrics-to-song
plugins.description: Turn complete lyrics, rough drafts, loose lines, or a hook into a structured Suno song with custom lyrics, clear sections, style, mood, arrangement, and vocal direction.

plugins.name: poster-design-studio
plugins.description: Turn a topic description, a product photo, or brand references into a scroll-stopping event poster, promotional banner, or social media graphic with strong visual hierarchy, category-matched styling, and text-safe zones.

plugins.name: ecommerce-listing-image-set
plugins.description: Turn verified SKU facts and product photos into a cohesive ecommerce image set with a hero image, feature visuals, lifestyle scenes, size views, and in-box images.

plugins.name: ai-image-generation-studio
plugins.description: Generate, compose, and edit product images, brand visuals, posters, social graphics, illustrations, and photo variations.

plugins.name: beatra-ai-video-studio
plugins.description: Generate, animate, edit, and extend short AI videos for ads, product stories, social posts, b-roll, transitions, and cinematic concepts.

plugins.name: ai-podcast-voiceover
plugins.description: Turn an article, notes, or finished script into a listenable solo podcast episode with a consistent host voice, natural pacing, pronunciation control, and MP3 delivery.

plugins.name: voiceover-narration-studio
plugins.description: Choose or reuse a voice, turn scripts into ready-to-edit narration, plan ordered long-form or multilingual audio, and create a reusable custom voice.

plugins.name: ai-multilingual-dubbing
plugins.description: Create reviewable multilingual voice-over audio from scripts for each language, with deliberate casting, pronunciation and timing pilots, and delivery organized by market and segment.

plugins.name: voice-cloning-studio
plugins.description: Create a reusable personal or brand voice from a clean audio sample, give it a memorable name, and hear it in a short test reading.

plugins.name: ai-photo-restyler
plugins.description: Turn a photo into anime, manga, comic, cartoon, watercolor, clay, or 3D character art while the subject stays recognisable, and repeat the same look across a whole set.

plugins.name: viral-video-teardown-remake
plugins.description: Paste the link or bring the file, break a short video that worked into its hook, beats, and call to action, then rebuild that structure around your own subject as a shot list, beat frames, and narration — delivered as one vertical clip animated from your opening frame, or, when the reference cuts too fast or runs too long for a single take, as segmented sources with captions and a timecoded edit list.

plugins.name: ai-headshot-studio
plugins.description: Turn a casual selfie into a studio-quality professional headshot with new backgrounds, professional attire, and studio lighting for LinkedIn, resume, company website, and social media.

plugins.name: ai-audiobook-narration
plugins.description: Turn final manuscript or course text into ordered chapter audio with one narrator, a representative sample, clear pricing, and focused refinements.

plugins.name: ai-image-realism
plugins.description: Make existing AI portraits, product images, and marketing visuals look more natural by fixing plastic skin, malformed hands and faces, repeated textures, and inconsistent lighting.

plugins.name: ai-storyboard-generator
plugins.description: Turn a script, scene, or ad brief into a practical shot list and one to four storyboard key-frame images.

plugins.name: wechat-cover-maker
plugins.description: Turn an article title, topic, or reference image into a WeChat Official Account cover, article hero image, post cover, or supporting article visual with headline-safe space and focused refinement.

plugins.name: zhongcao-cover-maker
plugins.description: Turn a photo or a topic idea into a scroll-stopping vertical 3:4 Xiaohongshu cover with clean backgrounds, bold focal composition, and text-safe areas for beauty, food, fashion, and lifestyle notes.

plugins.name: zhongcao-note-copywriter
plugins.description: Turn a product, experience, topic, or audience brief into Xiaohongshu title options, a readable note body, cover text, hashtags, and a natural comment starter.
